# Media Storage API — operations

7 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `medias.bulk-delete-media-objects` — **Bulk Delete / Trash Files/Folders** — `PUT /medias/delete-files` (write, location)
  Soft-deletes or trashes multiple files and folders in a single request
- `medias.bulk-update-media-objects` — **Bulk Update Files/Folders** — `PUT /medias/update-files` (write, location)
  Updates metadata or status of multiple files and folders
- `medias.create-media-folder` — **Create Folder** — `POST /medias/folder` (write, location)
  Creates a new folder in the media storage
- `medias.delete-media-content` — **Delete File or Folder** — `DELETE /medias/{id}` (write, location)
  Deletes specific file or folder from the media storage
- `medias.fetch-media-content` — **Get List of Files/Folders** — `GET /medias/files` (read, location)
  Fetches list of files and folders from the media storage
- `medias.update-media-object` — **Update File/Folder** — `POST /medias/{id}` (write, location)
  Updates a single file or folder by ID
- `medias.upload-media-content` — **Upload File into Media Storage** — `POST /medias/upload-file` (write, location, multipart)
  If hosted is set to true then fileUrl is required.
